desc: Ideation: forced-letter propagation, lastBreak static computation, greedy with forbidden-char buckets
Implement forced[] propagation for T-windows with conflict detection (return "" on mismatch)
Compute lastBreak[i] for each F-window; if a window has no breakable position, return ""
Greedy fill with active-window tracking: forbidden chars from windows whose lastBreak==j, pick smallest valid char, update broken/matching states, infeasibility if an unbroken window closes
Final verification pass over all windows as a safety net
Test: provided examples plus edge cases (periodic str2 with all T's, m=1, uniform str2, break-at-last-position)
Stress-test against brute-force oracle on small random inputs (n ≤ 6, m ≤ 3, alphabet 'ab') to validate correctness of greedy and infeasibility detection
Performance test at n=10⁴, m=500 (worst-case all-F and alternating patterns) to confirm runtime is acceptable
